scientific_integrity: Full proof and reproducible exact-arithmetic finite checks are included; earlier subset-sum and equidistribution tools are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: The zero-measure and linear-gap conclusions are almost-everywhere, not a characterization of all successful parameters.
The claim concerns the particular integer sequence \(2^n+1\), not all sequences approaching the doubling ratio.
The 2022 paper was inspected through its official abstract, not through its full primary text; unindexed priority remains a risk.
Finite numerical checks are corroborative only; the infinite proof is analytic.
title: A zero-measure completeness boundary for \((2^n+1)_{n\ge1}\)
